message.content: According to the discussion among the Game of Thrones fans, Merrick expresses a strong preference for Ramsay Bolton as the most hateable character. He finds Ramsay's character to be pure evil, which he believes makes him stand out significantly from the others. Merrick's view is supported by several other fans in the conversation, making him part of a group that includes Orion, Tamara, Saffron, Lachlan, and others who also rank Ramsay highly on the hateability scale. Ramsay's sadistic nature and his treatment of others left a strong impression on viewers, contributing to his reputation as one of the most detestable figures in the series. This consensus among the fans reflects their collective interpretation of Merrick's and their own experiences with the show's complex characters.
